scope.description: First-stage P3/P4 scientific-kernel implementation on synthetic frozen vectors: deterministic M1 primitives and explicit abstention for unsupported full clustering, versioned HP-family mapping, M2 precedence/power boundaries, exact Kx2/BH/BY, 16-cell conservation and Endpoint-B callability precedence. This task does not authorize HCC1395 production execution or phase promotion.

assumptions: Pinned historical Python may be executed only against synthetic/small vectors to freeze reference JSON; it must not read BAM, VCF, sidecar or production artifacts.
Production C++ never invokes Python and unsupported M1 compatibility states must explicitly abstain.
No successful historical full co-occurrence result may be promoted into an authority.
The parent task owns docs/development/implementation-notes.md and will record cross-kernel living-note decisions; this child must not write that file.

step_verify.step: Freeze small synthetic RNG, clustering-boundary, HP-family, M2 and co-occurrence vectors without production data.
step_verify.verify: Every JSON vector carries generator/source identity and all referenced inputs are synthetic.

step_verify.step: Implement deterministic C++ primitives and explicit unsupported-state abstention.
step_verify.verify: A direct C++17 compile succeeds with warnings enabled and the standalone test exits 0.

step_verify.step: Replay pinned-vector parity and independent brute-force negative cases.
step_verify.verify: Report exact case counts, decision/status mismatches, floating tolerances and remaining abstentions.

evidence.command: /usr/bin/g++ -std=c++17 -O0 -g -Wall -Wextra -Wpedantic -Wshadow -Wconversion -Wsign-conversion -Wformat=2 -Wundef -Werror -fno-fast-math -ffp-contract=off -Iinclude tests/unit/test_science_parity.cpp src/m1/science.cpp src/m1/hp_family.cpp src/m2/eligibility.cpp src/cooccurrence/statistics.cpp src/common/digest.cpp -ljansson -lcrypto -o /tmp/longlineage-science-parity-debug && /tmp/longlineage-science-parity-debug <REPO_ROOT>
evidence.output_excerpt: science_parity: PASS pinned_cases=99 independent_cases=2 negative_cases=5 m1_full_clustering=ABSTAIN_NOT_IMPLEMENTED production_python_calls=0

deviations: The first governance invocation used the absent build/bin path and exited 1; the latest executable under build-cpp-output-validation was then used successfully.
The first task-record patch accidentally duplicated heartbeat_at; strict governance rejected it before implementation, and the duplicate was removed before any science-file write.

The initial strict-threshold fixture set equality to 1.2945, which was below the prior 1.3 separation gate; the synthetic null vector was shifted so equality is 1.3945 and tests the intended later precedence branch.

Pre-handoff review found that historical MethylationParser materializes ML_raw / 255.0f as binary32 before matrix serialization; the C++ point estimator and frozen vectors were corrected from binary64 division while the distinct SAM [N/256,(N+1)/256) interval contract remained unchanged.

The repository publication repair later replaced private absolute-path strings in the receipt with portable tokens. The evidence SHA now binds that sanitized projection; scientific counters and verdict fields were not changed.
blockers: M1 recursive null generation, recursive labeling, ten coarse runs, fine run, ARI and full assignment parity remain explicit ABSTAIN_NOT_IMPLEMENTED.
CMake, CLI, schema/catalog, validator and provenance integration are outside this child write-set and require parent replay.
No formal production co-occurrence authority or HCC1395 full-run evidence is created by synthetic first-stage parity.
